text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Ugh... Squeezed out...
every last drop... Left it all out there...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: How is Brusqueman-san...?

text_block_list.name: Brusqueman
text_block_list.text: Uhh…….

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
She looks in so much pain... I thought she stayed
composed because her talent was on another level, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: They were at their limit, too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rushing over with a towel and an energy drink—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I feel like I was really
able to run true to myself today.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Brusqueman-san's sharpness was as incredible as ever—
even more polished than last year.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I can't run like that.
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Brusqueman-san couldn't run like I do, either.
Running like this, relying purely on stamina and throwing everything into it...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: This is me... A way of running that only I can do... Because each and every one of us ran in our own unique way...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UWAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
These cheers... To think this many people
are happy for me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Checking our answers for the first time in six months. Clashing against each other,
the Classic road that had been interrupted
finally reached its completion here."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan... This run is...
Squeezing out every single drop like this...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Have I... made it this far...?
Do I understand my own strengths?
Am I holding onto things I should have cast aside...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want to lose... I don't wanna lose...
I don't want to be left behind..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"This autumn, without fail—I'll seize a GⅠ.
And I will definitely rise to the top!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And after the award ceremony ended—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As for Brusqueman... it seems she hurt her leg slightly.
We are currently awaiting the exam results for further details, however.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Really!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but she looked satisfied.
To have run with you, Kitasan Black. Very satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Trained under her mother's disciplined tutelage,
she came to know herself more deeply in today's race.
This lesson will—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It will serve her well in the future. For herself,
and furthermore, for her successors.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...That said, considering your leg, going all out right away
might not be an option. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"This autumn... do your best for her sake too,
Kitasan Black."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: For Brusqueman-san's sake too...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yeah. We may not share blood, but our passion for running is the same...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And the only one she can entrust her feelings to...
is you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes! Yes, Air Groove-san!
I promise!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mm...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove gave a slight nod of her chin
and walked away.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, next is the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
right? And from there,
the triple GⅠ campaign of the second half...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Our opponents will get even stronger from here on,
and physically it seems like it'll be tougher and tougher, but...
choice_data_list: I've got to do my best, for Bruskman's sake too.
I've got to do my best, for Bruskman's sake too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! My heart feels... so warm!
I've received another huge boost of strength today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the weight and heat of the baton passed to her,
Kitasan Black took yet another step forward—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the Spring GⅠ Triple Crown campaign came to a close.
